apiConfig.title: API Config Management
apiConfig.codexAdvancedHint: Codex profiles imported from ~/.codex or cc-switch may also carry raw CONFIG_TOML / AUTH_JSON payloads. The values below are read-only views of what is currently stored; editing Base URL, model, or API key will regenerate the corresponding field.
apiConfig.noConfigs: No configs. Click "+ New" to add an API config.
apiConfig.ccSwitchEmpty: No importable configs found in cc-switch.
apiConfig.notesClaude: For Claude shells, these profiles inject the selected API key and model settings into the new shell. When no profile is selected, Nexus uses the current system ~/.claude/settings.json directly.
apiConfig.notesCodex: Codex profiles materialize an isolated data/codex-runtime/<window> HOME for each tmux window. With a profile selected, Nexus writes that profile into the temporary .codex directory; without a profile, it copies the current live ~/.codex config and login state, including ChatGPT auth.

apiConfig.syncedNotice: Synced the current system config into: {{id}}
apiConfig.ccSwitchSyncHistoryNotice: Codex history synced to the current provider
